description: Elections Commission - G. M. Daya of the Seethawaka Pura Urban Council has Vacated his office of Members of the United National Party, D. P. R. Wickramasinghe of the Seethawaka Pura Urban Council has Vacated his office of Members of the United National Party
reasoning: This gazette notice concerns the vacation of office by members of a local authority (Seethawakapura Urban Council) due to ceasing membership in a political party. This falls under electoral processes and local government elections matters, specifically addressing the status of elected members as governed by the Local Authorities Elections Ordinance. It fits Type 7 (Elections Gazettes) which covers electoral processes, candidate registrations, and declarations about elected officials' status.
